lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits. Centroids form approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows within the primary field of view, creating a repeating rectangular lattice.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots. These intersections form high-contrast anchor nodes that define the grid structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank. Each is characterized by a bright upper margin and a shadowed lower margin, indicating a longitudinal protrusion extending from the branchial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin exhibits a cluster of high-luminance blobs. These spots are smaller and less regularly spaced than those on the flank, concentrated primarily in the anterior and central regions of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small remoras (Echeneidae) attached to the flank near the gills and dorsal ridge. A cluster of small yellow fish (likely Gnathanodon speciosus) is visible near the rostrum.
